useWhen: Defining minimum security posture for product launch
Asking what security measures are needed before launching
Determining what security requirements to implement

workflow.description: Gather architecture inputs, classify data sensitivity, determine threat profile, assess team capability
Apply authentication, session management, access control, input validation, cryptography requirements to architecture
Classify requirements as P0 (must have at launch), P1 (within 3 months), P2 (within 6 months)
Create prioritized checklist with requirement statements, implementation guidance, verification methods, effort estimates
Flag risks from third-party dependencies, default configurations, deployment pipeline, data flows
Calculate security posture score, list top 5 actions, document deferred items, create handoff notes

examples.input: What security requirements do we need before launching our B2B SaaS app?
examples.output: Security requirements baseline with prioritized P0/P1/P2 checklist, tech-stack-specific implementation guidance
examples.context: Pre-launch SaaS product needing security requirements

examples.input: Secure our MVP before production deployment
examples.output: Launch-critical security checklist with auth, encryption, input validation requirements for MVP
examples.context: Solo founder preparing first production deployment
